en: Dependent on an indeterminate resultant state, a non-wholesome state that is not a resultant arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three;
under predominance condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
Dependent on a wholesome state that has the nature of producing a result, a non-wholesome state that does not have the nature of producing a result arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome state that is subject to ripening, an unwholesome state that is not subject to ripening arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a wholesome state that is subject to ripening, both an unwholesome state that is not subject to ripening and a neither-wholesome-nor-unwholesome state that is not subject to ripening arise by way of root condition. … three.
Dependent on an unwholesome state that is subject to ripening, an unwholesome state not subject to ripening arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome state that is subject to ripening, a wholesome state not subject to ripening arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome state that is subject to ripening, both a wholesome state not subject to ripening and an unwholesome state not subject to ripening arise [by way of root condition].
And states arise by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.
In the case of roots, there are six; in the case of predominance, six … pe … in the case of non-disappearance, six.
Dependent on an indeterminate state that is neither resultant nor productive of result, there arises an unwholesome state that is neither resultant nor productive of result.
[An unwholesome state] arises with root condition, dependent on an indeterminate state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants.

[A state] that is neither unwholesome nor of a nature to produce resultants arises with root condition, dependent on an indeterminate state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants.

[A state] that is neither wholesome nor of a nature to produce resultants and [a state] that is neither unwholesome nor of a nature to produce resultants arise with root condition, dependent on an indeterminate state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants.
And mental phenomena arise with root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.
